notes: three co-transmitters at the first level («جميعا» meets at Sa'd b. Abd Allah); «رحمهم الله» and «(رحمه الله)» are left out
«عن بعض أصحابنا» is an unnamed link; «عن أبي عبد الله (ع)» stays a narrator because it sits in the chain after «عن»
Ali speaks in the story («نظر أمير المؤمنين ... فقال يا عبرة كل مؤمن»), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); Husayn's reply («فقال أنا يا أبتاه») is inside the same speech and is not given a link
